name: 1.23.0-beta.27
notes: Editing a fixes mod: picture fixes show the picture they use, with the name the game looks for; “Change” opens the game's pictures to choose another. After changing, saving or deleting something the file stays open where you were (closing the picture chooser goes back to it too).
Pictures, tiles and buttons can no longer be selected like text, so they no longer turn blue after a long press or a drag.
